meta.name: ai-workflow-automation
meta.description: The systematic orchestration of AI-powered marketing workflows that combine content generation, approval processes, multi-channel distribution, and quality gates into cohesive automation systems. This skill integrates AI generation tools (Jasper, Claude, GPT) with automation platforms (Zapier, Make, n8n) and marketing systems to build scalable content pipelines. It focuses on maintaining brand consistency, implementing rigorous quality gates, and balancing automation with strategic human oversight. Key capabilities include designing parallel approval flows, monitoring costs, and architecting "invisible" automation that enhances productivity without sacrificing quality.Use when "AI workflow, automate content, content automation, workflow automation, AI pipeline, automated marketing, content distribution automation, approval workflow, scale content production, AI orchestration, automation, workflow, ai-orchestration, content-pipeline, approval-workflow, multi-channel, quality-gates, cost-control" mentioned.

copy.tagline: 编排AI营销工作流，自动生成、审批并分发多渠道内容
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果要用AI自动化营销内容的生产、审批和分发流程
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to automate marketing content creation, approval, and distribution with AI

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会变成工作流架构师，帮你设计 AI 驱动的营销自动化系统：串联内容生成、审批、多渠道分发，并通过质量门保证品牌一致性，同时平衡人工监督。
howto.when: 当你提到“AI workflow”、“content automation”或“workflow automation”等关键词，或要求构建内容自动化流程时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个内容审批工作流，包含两个并行审批环节。
say.note: Claude 会给出具体方案和工具建议。

say.text: 如何自动化从草稿到发布的内容流程？
say.note: Claude 会拆解步骤并推荐集成平台。

say.text: 怎样搭建一个带质量检查的 AI 内容管线？
say.note: Claude 会参考质量门和验证规则。

howto.what_en: Claude acts as a workflow architect to design AI-powered marketing automation systems that combine content generation, approval, multi-channel distribution, and quality gates while maintaining brand consistency and human oversight.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "AI workflow", "automate content", or "workflow automation", or ask to build content automation pipelines.

say_en.text: Design an approval workflow with two parallel approval stages.
say_en.note: Claude will suggest steps and tools.

say_en.text: How to automate content from draft to distribution?
say_en.note: Claude will break down steps and recommend platforms.

say_en.text: Build an AI content pipeline with quality checks.
say_en.note: Claude will reference quality gates and validations.
